SELECT T2."XCL_006" AS EyeColor, COUNT(T1."XCL_018") AS HeroCount
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1."XCL_022" = T2."XCL_005"
WHERE T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics' AND T1."XCL_029" IS NULL
GROUP BY T2."XCL_006"
ORDER BY HeroCount DESC
LIMIT 1
